description: Unit tests for the ProxyServer class, testing constructors, parsing, validation, comparison, and properties.

methods.name: DefaultConstructor
methods.description: Tests default constructor of ProxyServer, expecting invalid state.

methods.name: FromSchemeHostAndPort
methods.description: Tests creation of ProxyServer from scheme, host, and port, including canonicalization and validation.

methods.name: InvalidHostname
methods.description: Tests invalid hostnames are correctly identified as invalid ProxyServer instances.

methods.name: InvalidPort
methods.description: Tests invalid port values are correctly identified as invalid ProxyServer instances.

methods.name: ComparatorAndEquality
methods.description: Tests comparison operators and equality for ProxyServer instances.

methods.name: Properties
methods.description: Tests the is_http(), is_https(), is_http_like(), and is_secure_http_like() methods for different proxy types.
